name: vscode-worktree-manager
description: Per-worktree identity and fast switching for git worktrees

virtualWorkspaces.description: Needs a real filesystem and the git binary.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Runs git commands in the opened folder.

worktreeManager.hooks.postCreate.markdownDescription: Shell command run after a worktree is created, from the primary worktree. Receives `WORKTREE_PATH`, `WORKTREE_BRANCH`, `WORKTREE_SOURCE` and `WORKTREE_PURPOSE` in its environment. Empty disables it. Set this in the repo's `.vscode/settings.json` so it travels with the repo.

worktreeManager.hooks.preDelete.markdownDescription: Shell command run **before** a worktree is deleted, from the primary worktree. A non-zero exit aborts the deletion, so a failed teardown cannot leave the worktree removed and its stack running. Empty disables it.

worktreeManager.worktreesRoot.markdownDescription: Where new worktrees are created. Empty resolves to `<parent of the primary worktree>/worktrees`.

nonce.description: Identifies one hook run, so its exit code can be matched back.

scripts.build: bun build src/extension.ts --outdir dist --target node --format cjs --external vscode --minify
scripts.dev: bun build src/extension.ts --outdir dist --target node --format cjs --external vscode --watch
scripts.package: bun run build && bun x @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies --skip-license --allow-missing-repository
